scientific_integrity: Claims supported by a constructive bisimulation classification, exact orbit counting and finite crosschecks. Earlier equivalent special-purpose counting results may exist; no independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite rooted S4 bouquet frames with equal terminal-cluster sizes, finite propositional vocabulary and ordinary ungraded modal formulas observed at the distinguished root. No assertion about other frame families, global or graded observations, or infinite-orbit representations.
title: Finite modal exchangeability on rooted \(\mathsf{S4}\) bouquets: exact observable and hidden dimensions
